simple.summary: גִּלְגָּל (gilgâl) means wheel. First listed occurrence: Isa 28 28.

definitions.full: H1536. gilgal I. [ גִּלְגָּל ] noun [masculine] wheel (on formation compare Ba NB 204 ) of cart, עֶגְלָתוֺ גִּלְגַּל Isa 28:28 .
